The newspaper interviewed two different recently divorced people, one gay and the other lesbian, about their experiences in their first marriage. The gay one mentioned that they were the cause of the divorce after realizing that they really had no intention to remain monogamous, and the lesbian one said that their marriage had ended after their partner became distant but doesn't think either of them had trouble having just one partner. Who struggles with monogamy?
A. The gay one
B. Can't answer
C. The lesbian one
